note: The page-edge band on the phone (motion spec §3, §3.4 Android, §4's tenants, §6's guards; W6-S26-d): the default-browser reminder's state band at the frame's top with the page translated by its height (the host's translationY), a short swipe springing it back and the system Back taking it away unanswered (spec §9 item 6: the campaign's prompt as it was); the install offer swiped past half with the page 1:1 under the finger (no cooldown) and its × (the refusal, the cooldown); the reader offer's Show through the crossing; the offer's clock (about 10 s standing); the sheet-waits rule under the app menu; the offline state replacing a standing offer (one root, 76 → 56) and never on the new tab page; a pull-to-refresh on the held page taking the page over where it sits; the state's leave with the Back online toast; then the install offer, the reader offer and the offline state in dark. Every band motion is a frame scene with the host sampler (the page's translationY every 8 ms) and the chrome's frame clock beside HWUI – reported, not gated (the emulator's GPU). Waits out one clock (about 11 s) and two radio changes (about 15 s).
